timing_fences.sequence_processing: Starts immediately before input0 RGB-to-plane conversion, after encoder/decoder open. Encode and decode are interleaved per emitted packet; ends after final decoder flush conversion. Includes Python bookkeeping, excludes artifact writes/header inspection. Preloaded unpaced software sequence, not capture-to-display latency.
timing_fences.first_packet_elapsed_ms: Sequence processing start to first native encoded packet observed in Python, before that packet is decoded.
timing_fences.first_decoded_output_elapsed_ms: Sequence processing start to first RGB output from the interleaved native decoder and canonical inverse.
timing_fences.decode_call_start_to_rgb_ready_ms: Start of this packet decode call to canonical RGB output readiness, independent of encoder/open/previous packet costs.
timing_fences.encode_call_ms: Only AVCodecContext.encode call; excludes color conversion and plane copying.
timing_fences.decode_ms: Only AVCodecContext.decode call; excludes canonical inverse conversion.

color_contract: GM01 frozen gm.ft.rgb_to_planes and gm.ft.planes_to_rgb for every codec; full-range 8-bit YUV420 samples, no swscale RGB conversion
scope: Native CPU software call timing and emitted stream evidence only. Preloaded RGB; no capture/network/display, FPGA decoding, target memory, or hardware throughput proof. Codec reference policy differs from GM01.
